title: The Coastal Cottage
meta_description: The Coastal Cottage: Renovated 3BR beach retreat with alfresco patio, modern kitchen, and steps from Emerald Coast's Public Beach Access 95.
description_expanded:
Welcome to The Coastal Cottage! Just a 2-minute stroll from the sun-drenched shores of the Emerald Coast, this newly renovated beach retreat offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience. Thoughtfully updated with fresh flooring, designer lighting, and modern finishes, The Coastal Cottage is ready to host your unforgettable getaway.

Step inside to an open-concept living space, where coastal charm meets contemporary elegance. The newly painted interior creates a bright and airy ambiance, while brand-new lighting and ceiling fans add a fresh, polished touch. The main living area invites relaxation with a spacious sectional sofa and a large TV---perfect for movie nights after a day in the sun. Gather around the dining table for shared meals, or grab a quick bite at the kitchen barstools. The fully equipped kitchen has been beautifully updated with new countertops, a stylish backsplash, and a sleek new sink, making meal prep a breeze.

For seamless indoor-outdoor living, the enclosed patio offers a comfortable retreat with plush lounge seating, a TV, and a dining area ready for alfresco BBQs. Soak up the sunshine from the front yard loungers, or head up to the balcony to savor the salty sea breeze with your morning coffee. And when you're ready to hit the sand, Public Beach Access 95 is just steps away!

After a day of beachside adventures, retreat to one of three beautifully redesigned bedrooms, each offering a tranquil escape. The primary suite, boasting an ensuite bathroom, and the second bedroom both feature luxurious king beds, while the third bedroom is perfect for families or groups with four full beds. With two full bathrooms, everyone can enjoy space and privacy.

Embrace the elegance and ease of coastal living at The Coastal Cottage---a stunning, newly refreshed haven just moments from the beach!

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Hub 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Laguna Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- Parking for up to 4 cars in the driveway and front of the yard.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
